这篇从“孩子已经在别处上学，我们现在搬来”开始。最终要拿到五项确认：接收学校、第: Start here if your child already attends school elsewhere and you are moving now. Aim to confirm five things: receiving school, first-day time, class or timetable, health and learning-support contacts, and daily transportation. “Submitted” is an intermediate status; do not wait for next year’s application cycle to ask about current enrollment.
先从已有区域指南确认负责学区: Use the regional guides to identify the responsible district
旧金山、东湾、半岛、南湾和北湾已有各自学校总览；先按完整地址、孩子年级与 202: Use the existing San Francisco, East Bay, Peninsula, South Bay, and North Bay school guides to identify the enrollment office for your full address, grade, and 2026–27 school year. Siblings in different grades may belong to different districts.
说明是新搬入该区、原区内换校，还是想住在区外继续就读。三种情形的表格和批准环节不: Specify whether you are moving into the district, changing schools within it, or seeking attendance while living outside it. The forms and approvals differ; avoid duplicate student records.
先看旧金山学校与学区入口: Start with the San Francisco school guide
已有五区总览负责查区和选校；本篇继续处理学年中报到的材料与衔接。: The regional guides cover districts and school options; this guide continues with midyear records and onboarding.
东湾家庭：先找负责地址的学区: East Bay families: identify the district for your address
从 Alameda 或 Contra Costa 县的官方目录进入，不按城市名推: Start with the official Alameda or Contra Costa county directory; a city name does not determine a school.
半岛家庭：分别核对小学与高中学区: Peninsula families: check elementary and high-school districts separately
不同年级可能需要两套申请与档案交接。: Different grades may require separate applications and record transfers.
南湾家庭：按目标学年核对边界: South Bay families: check boundaries for the intended year
查清实际负责学区后，再选择对应注册系统。: Identify the responsible district before choosing its registration system.
北湾家庭：按县找到招生办公室: North Bay families: locate the enrollment office by county
Marin、Sonoma、Napa 分别查询，再由具体学区确认。: Search Marin, Sonoma, or Napa separately, then confirm with the responsible district.
离开旧校前：先问接收方式，再索取档案: Before leaving: ask how records should be transferred
联系新学区，问旧校应寄给谁、电子或密封纸本是否接受、是否需要家长签 record: Ask the new district who receives records, whether electronic or sealed paper delivery is accepted, and whether a parental release is needed. Give the receiving contact to the former school’s registrar. Keep readable copies to explain courses and support, but let the receiving office decide whether they can replace official records.
学生信息：姓名、出生日期、当前年级、原校名称和联系人；按要求准备出生证明、家长身: Student details: name, birth date, current grade, former school, and contact. Prepare birth, parent identification, and guardianship records as requested.
学习记录：最近成绩单、正在修读的课程、学期起止与评分说明；高中另问是否需要课程描: Academic records: recent reports, current courses, term dates, and grading information. For high school, ask about course descriptions, credits earned, and grades for courses still in progress.
支持记录：已有 IEP、504 计划、语言评估或相关校内支持文件；向接收方问安全: Support records: existing IEPs, 504 plans, language assessments, or other school support documents. Use the receiving office’s secure transfer method.
健康记录：保留原始免疫记录和日期，问是否需要翻译、TB clearance 或当: Health records: retain original immunization records and dates, and ask about translations, TB clearance, or local health forms. School health staff review them.
与两校协调旧校最后出勤日和新校预计开始日，记录交接中的未完成事项。归还设备、图书: Coordinate the last attendance date and expected new start date with both schools. Follow the former school’s instructions for returns and withdrawal. If records are delayed, tell the receiving office exactly what is missing and whom you contacted, then ask what can proceed rather than delaying enrollment indefinitely yourself.
住址材料：同一份账单不一定通用: Residence documents are not interchangeable across districts
先拿目标学区当前清单，逐项标记“已有／需补／需问替代”。以 SFUSD 为例，其: Mark each item on the district’s current list as available, missing, or requiring an alternative. SFUSD, for example, specifies a 45-day window for some recent documents, separately lists current leases and other documents, and excludes cell-phone bills as address proof. Do not apply its document counts, dates, or forms to other districts.
合住、住址与证件不一致或缺标准账单时，先找招生人员问学校认可的声明或核验流程。S: For shared housing, mismatched addresses, or missing bills, ask enrollment staff about accepted affidavits or verification. SMUHSD lists shared-residence/caregiver forms; SFUSD describes affidavits for certain unavailable documents. Do not treat another person’s bill as your own proof or alter names or dates.
三个地区的当前学年提交节点: Current-year submission checkpoints in three areas
SFUSD：选 2026–27 当前年，再联系招生顾问: SFUSD: choose the current 2026–27 year and contact a counselor
可走 ParentVUE，或按页面提交纸本／PDF。学年中需要分配学校时，联系: Use ParentVUE or the paper/PDF process shown on the page. For midyear placement, contact the Enrollment Center at 415-241-6085 and explain what is submitted or missing.
SMFCSD：在线注册后，完成第四步文件核验: SMFCSD: complete document verification after registration
Aeries Registration 与已有学生 Parent Portal: Aeries Registration and the existing-student Parent Portal use separate accounts. Registration is complete after document verification. A closed priority window does not end midyear registration; ask about placement if the grade is full.
SJUSD：用正确边界版本，等工作人员确认: SJUSD: use the correct boundary version and obtain staff confirmation
2026–27 与 2027–28 以后分用 locator。线上交件或到 En: Separate locators apply to 2026–27 and 2027–28 onward. After online submission or Enrollment Center assistance, requirements and a staff confirmation email are still needed. Ask about documents and assistance at 408-535-6412.
半岛高中家庭另用 SMUHSD 的 current school year 链接: Peninsula high-school families should use SMUHSD’s current-school-year link rather than the prominently displayed 2027–28 dates. Student Services emails verification and placement after review. Ask about missing documents at 650-558-2251 or enrollment@smuhsd.org. Portal submission alone does not confirm readiness to attend classes.
健康与学习支持：交给负责人员接续: Hand health and learning support to the responsible staff
健康文件看不懂或原校还未寄到，联系 school health office，提: If health records are unclear or delayed, contact the school health office with the originals you have. CDPH has specific rules for obtaining transfer records; the school determines applicability. Do not independently translate vaccine equivalencies, decide additional doses, or declare attendance clearance. Ask which qualified provider should complete any needed assessment or form.
孩子在校需要用药、过敏应对或其他健康安排时，提前问校方表格、医护签字及交接方式。: For medication, allergy response, or other school health needs, ask about forms, clinician signatures, and handover. SJUSD’s health page provides contacts and documents; other districts have their own procedures. Confirm who receives records and coordinates daily communication rather than assuming a parent note completes the arrangements.
已有 IEP 或 504 计划时，在申请阶段就告知招生办公室，请其连接接收学校的: Tell enrollment staff about an existing IEP or 504 plan and request contact with the receiving team. List current supports, the former school contact, and available records. Ask who will discuss continuity before attendance, how to reach them in week one, and whether further assessments are needed. Do not wait merely because the portal lacks an upload field.
如实填写 Home Language Survey，说明孩子已学过的语言、原来课: Complete the Home Language Survey accurately, describing the child’s languages, former instructional language, and the family’s preferred communication language. Ask about assessments, timing, attendance during assessment, and support contacts. Speaking Chinese at home does not automatically place a child in a particular language program.
高中转入：在第一张课表前做一次课程核对: High-school transfers: review courses before the first timetable
约 counselor，带成绩单与正在修读的课程列表，逐项问哪些学分已被接受、哪: Meet the counselor with transcripts and current courses; ask which credits are accepted and which remain under review.
把旧校学期结束日、尚未结课科目和考试安排说清楚，问新课表能否接续、是否需要补交成: Explain former term dates, unfinished courses, and examinations; ask how the new timetable connects and whether later grades are required.
毕业要求、课程先修和大学申请安排分开核对；不自行把海外课程或 AP／IB 名称等: Review graduation requirements, prerequisites, and college applications separately. Do not assume overseas courses or AP/IB titles automatically translate into local credit.
两种卡点：学校满额与暂时没有稳定住所: Two obstacles: full schools and unstable housing
地址对应学校满额时，向招生办公室问可安排的学校、开始日期、候补规则和接送办法。S: If the neighborhood school is full, ask about an available school, start date, waitlist, and transportation. SMFCSD and SJUSD both describe alternate placement when capacity is reached. An address or school tour does not reserve a seat. Record the immediate attendance arrangement separately from any return waitlist.
因失去住房、经济困难等暂住他人家、旅馆或其他不稳定住所时，向学区 homeles: If housing loss, economic hardship, or similar circumstances leave you staying with others, in a motel, or in unstable housing, describe the situation to the district homeless liaison. CDE explains immediate-enrollment protections for eligible students despite missing routine records. Ask the liaison about eligibility and procedures; not every short-term rental or hotel stay qualifies.
材料与住房障碍：查看 CDE 官方说明: Documentation and housing barriers: read CDE guidance
向负责学区索取 liaison 联系方式，提供问题与已有申请记录，避免在公开群发: Ask the responsible district for its liaison and provide the issue and application records through official channels.
报到前与第一周：把生活安排接上: Before arrival and during week one: connect daily routines
收到工作人员确认后，问第一天到哪个办公室、几点、由谁迎接，家长是否需陪同；保存校: After staff confirmation, ask which office to visit, when, who will greet the student, and whether a parent should attend. Save the calendar and absence-reporting process.
核对接送授权、放学出口、午餐、设备登录与家校消息系统；课后项目单独问名额、收费、: Check pickup authorization, dismissal exit, meals, device access, and school messaging. Ask separately about after-school spaces, fees, assistance, and closing time; school enrollment does not reserve child care.
编辑建议在到校后第三天及第一周末各核对一次：课表能用、支持联系人接通、家长收到消: Editorial suggestion: check around day three and the end of week one that the timetable works, support contacts are reachable, messages arrive, and transportation functions. Assign each gap to the responsible staff member.

完成标准是孩子已经有可执行的到校与课程安排，待补件有联系人和下一次跟进日期。保留: Completion means a workable attendance and class plan, with a responsible contact and follow-up date for remaining documents. Keep review emails, the timetable, and key contacts. Finishing an online form is not the end of the process.
